description: This file defines the InvestMatcherListener class, which handles event-driven processing related to investment matching, including processing payments, updating investment drops, and generating notification feeds within the Goteo crowdfunding platform.

classes.name: InvestMatcherListener
classes.description: Listener class for managing investment matching processes, including handling payments, updating investments, and generating activity feeds based on successful investments within the application.

methods.name: processPayments
methods.description: Processes investments drops and updates related investments and feeds, given a matcher, processor, and optional investment data.

methods.name: onInvestSuccess
methods.description: Handles the event of a successful investment, updates matcher data, and triggers payment processing for relevant matchers.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns the list of events this listener subscribes to, specifically INVEST_SUCCEEDED with a low processing priority.
